description.en: Bring Get笔记 (biji.com) into DSH as one sidebar entry and a single panel. Work directly on cloud notes (read, rewrite, delete, tag, semantic search, share links, play the original recording) and mirror everything into local Markdown — directory tree, tag cloud, full-text search, editing and creating all work offline, and already-synced notes stay readable and writable after any membership ends. Two cloud channels, pick either: one-click OAuth sign-in, or an API key from the openapi.biji.com console pasted into settings; a rejected key falls back to the sign-in channel automatically. Auto-sync is off by default and, once enabled, pulls new notes on schedule while DSH runs. Writes always favour your edits: notes you wrote by hand are never overwritten, newer cloud versions are only saved aside under .conflicts.
description.zh: 把得到大脑（Get笔记 / biji.com）接进 DSH：左侧栏一个入口，中央一块面板。既直接操作云端笔记（浏览、改写、删除、加标签、语义搜索、生成分享链接、播放原始录音），也把一切镜像成本地 Markdown 文件——目录树、标签云、全文搜索、编辑、新建全部离线可用，会员到期后已同步的内容照常能读能写。云端两条通道任选一条：点一次「登录得到大脑」完成 OAuth 授权，或去 openapi.biji.com 控制台取 API Key 填进设置；Key 被拒会自动回落到登录通道。自动同步默认关闭，开启后只要 DSH 在跑就按时拉新笔记。写文件一律偏向保住你自己的改动：你手写过的笔记永不被覆盖，云端新版本只会另存进 .conflicts。
